messages:
Aisha Patel: FYI — flagged an unusual drop for QuantumLeaf. Daily active tokens down ~62% WoW on their dedicated deployment. Dashboard: https://redwood.app/d/QLeaf/usage
Ravi Kumar: ugh, that’s sizable. Do we know when their procurement/contact change happened?
Aisha Patel: saw a note in CRM — procurement lead swapped last week (from CTO -> Product PM). Visa-call with PM next Tue.
Diego Morales: any sign of a competitive pilot?
Aisha Patel: PM mentioned trying a vendor P in their last email. Low usage started 3 days after pilot kickoff.
Lin Zhou: ok — risk profile = usage drop + stakeholder swap + competitor trial. Recommend immediate playbook: 1) quick health call, 2) targeted invoice/credit offer, 3) product session (2x15m) for PM.
Ravi Kumar: agree. Can we get a short snapshot for execs? small table: current seats=18, active seats=4, avg tokens/day=8k (prev 22k).
Aisha Patel: posting a query snippet for Diego to pull SLA/latency tickets quickly:
```
SELECT date, sum(tokens) as tokens
FROM usage.events
WHERE account = 'quantumleaf'
GROUP BY date
ORDER BY date DESC
LIMIT 14;
```
Diego Morales: running it now. also will check error rates and recent deploys.
oncall-bot: Meeting created: "QuantumLeaf: health check" on 2026-04-06 16:00 PT — invite sent to PM + CTO + Aisha + Ravi + Diego :calendar:
Ravi Kumar: nice. Aisha, can you draft a 3-bullet agenda we can send to the PM before the call? keep it lightweight.
Aisha Patel: draft: 1) quick snapshot + what we saw, 2) ask about pilot goals + blockers, 3) offer short technical deep-dive + free trial extension. sending now.
Diego Morales: pulled usage window — tokens decline starts 2026-03-28. No increased error spikes; latency stable. suggests behavior change, not reliability.
Lin Zhou: good signal — leaning competitive. Plan: prep a concise slide w/ ROI highlights and 1-2 low-effort product wins to win back seats. Ravi, can you own pricing/credit ask?
Ravi Kumar: on it. I'll propose a 60-day trial expansion + 10% discount for midterm commit if they recover usage.
Aisha Patel: capturing action items: A) Send agenda & short ROI note (Aisha), B) Price/credit proposal (Ravi), C) Technical deep-dive draft + infra check (Diego), D) Slide deck for execs (Lin).
Diego Morales: noted — I'll also check model variant routing and whether their calls have been routed to lower-capacity pool recently.
Ravi Kumar: timeline: agenda to PM by EOD today, pricing to be ready before meeting, deck draft by EOD Mon.
Aisha Patel: thanks team. I'll ping PM thread with agenda and include a link to our customer success checklist. :pray:
Lin Zhou: mildly worried about churn but we have a decent window to influence. keep this high-touch for now.
Aisha Patel: will update thread after PM reply.
Ravi Kumar: thumbs up.
(oncall-bot reaction: :bell: 1767123590)
